title: Slider in AnimationNodeBlendTree is affected by the zoom level
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in:
v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6]
v4.7.stable.mono.official [5b4e0cb0f]

Not reproducible in:
v4.3.stable.mono.official [77dcf97d8]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable.mono - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6607) - AMD Ryzen 9 5900HX with Radeon Graphics (16 threads) - 31.42 GiB memory - WASAPI (48000 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

If the view in the AnimationNodeBlendTree is zoomed in/out the slider does not track the mouse correctly. See attached video for the example of the issue. When the view is zoomed it you have to move mouse more to make slider move the same amount when not zoomed in. And when you zoomed out - the small change in mouse position results in great change in slider.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d8eef9dd-5236-468a-a73f-7f50cf3d048b

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open a new project
2. Add an animation tree and animation player
3. Assign animation player to animation tree and select AnimationNodeBlendTree  as tree root
4. Add a Blend2/Blend3 node to the tree
5. Zoom in or out in the animation tree view and try dragging the slider

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Any new empty project will work.
